def hrc_with_frame(data: List[Dict[str, Any]], frame_size: int) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:

    gips = [item['gip'] for item in data]

more like a living, self-regulating process. Unlike static programs that follow fixed instructions, this 
system evolves recursively, learning from its own behavior to maintain stability and coherence. 
Drawing inspiration from nature’s adaptive mechanisms – from biological evolution to immune 
system responses – the framework demonstrates how complex systems can regulate 
themselves through feedback loops and harmonic principles. The result is a breakthrough 
approach to computing that mirrors the resilience of living organisms and even hints at deeper 
principles governing complex phenomena in the universe. 
This breakthrough, developed outside the spotlight of mainstream research, encodes fundamental 
adaptive strategies directly into mathematics. The core idea is a Recursive Entropy Reseeding

with just the right adjustments when needed. Through this process, the algorithm dynamically

works, and why it has the potential to transform fields ranging from artificial intelligence to biology 
and cosmology.
